Subtitle: All Natural Dairy Compost
Brief Overview: Aged, screened, biologically active dairy compost produced right here in Arizona. Simon's Gold is the foundation of every SSW blend, delivering balanced nutrients and microbial diversity to feed your soil naturally.
Key Features/benefits: Rich in beneficial microbes, balanced NPK, improves soil structure and water retention.
Target audience: Landscapers, Nurseries, Farms, Golf Courses, Commercial Growers
Recommended Uses: Soil enrichment, topdressing, backfill amendment, raised bed preparation
Gardener Usage Instructions: Blend 2-3 inches into existing soil before planting, or topdress around established plants. Water thoroughly after application.

Subtitle: Pure Organic Vermicompost
Brief Overview: Pure, OMRI-certified worm castings produced in our own vermicompost operation. Packed with beneficial microbes and slow-release nutrients to boost plant health, root development, and soil biology.
Key Features/benefits: Gentle, slow-release nutrients. Rich in humic acid and beneficial microorganisms. Will not burn plants.
Target audience: Nurseries, Home Gardeners, Organic Farmers, Landscapers, Cannabis Growers
Recommended Uses: Topdressing, seed starting, transplanting, compost tea brewing, container gardening
Gardener Usage Instructions: Mix into soil at 10-20% by volume, or topdress with a thin layer around plants. For compost tea, steep 1 cup per gallon of water.

Subtitle: Tree & Shrub Planting Amendment
Brief Overview: Formulated for root health in trees and shrubs. Enriches the backfill with dairy compost and volcanic tuff to build a stronger root environment for new and established plantings.
Key Features/benefits: Promotes deep root establishment, improves soil structure around root zone, reduces transplant stress.
Target audience: Landscapers, Tree Services, Nurseries, HOA Maintenance, Municipal Parks
Recommended Uses: Tree planting backfill, shrub bed preparation, root zone topdressing
Gardener Usage Instructions: Blend into backfill at a 1:3 ratio with native soil when planting trees or shrubs. For existing plants, topdress around the drip line and water in.

Subtitle: Golf Course Tee Top Divot Repair Mix
Brief Overview: Precision-blended for fast turf recovery on golf courses. Fills divots with nutrient-rich organic matter that promotes rapid regrowth and blends seamlessly with existing turf.
Key Features/benefits: Fast germination support, blends with existing turf, nutrient-rich for quick recovery.
Target audience: Golf Courses, Sports Turf Managers, Country Clubs, Municipal Parks
Recommended Uses: Divot repair, tee box renovation, fairway topdressing
Gardener Usage Instructions: Fill divots level with the blend, press firmly, and water. For tee boxes, spread a thin layer and overseed.

Subtitle: Overseed & Aeration Blend
Brief Overview: Designed for overseeding and post-aeration topdressing. Feeds the turf with organic nutrients while improving soil contact for new seed, promoting thick, healthy grass growth.
Key Features/benefits: Ideal particle size for overseeding, improves seed-to-soil contact, feeds existing turf.
Target audience: Landscapers, HOA Maintenance, Sports Turf Managers, Lawn Care Professionals
Recommended Uses: Overseed topdressing, post-aeration amendment, lawn renovation
Gardener Usage Instructions: After aeration, spread a 1/4 inch layer evenly over the lawn. Overseed as desired and water thoroughly.

Subtitle: Biochar Carbon Soil Conditioning
Brief Overview: Pre-charged biochar amendment that builds long-term carbon storage in soil. Improves water retention, nutrient holding capacity, and microbial habitat for healthier, more resilient soil.
Key Features/benefits: Long-lasting soil carbon, improves CEC (cation exchange capacity), boosts microbial populations.
Target audience: Farms, Landscapers, Nurseries, Organic Growers, Regenerative Agriculture
Recommended Uses: Soil conditioning, carbon sequestration, compost enhancement, raised bed amendment
Gardener Usage Instructions: Blend into soil at 5-10% by volume. For best results, mix with compost before application to 'charge' the biochar with nutrients.

Subtitle: Palm & Date Tree Plant Food
Brief Overview: Tailored nutrition for palms and date trees. Oasis Blend delivers the specific nutrient balance these desert staples need for strong trunk development, healthy fronds, and productive fruit sets.
Key Features/benefits: Balanced potassium for palm health, promotes frond color and fruit production, desert-adapted formula.
Target audience: Landscapers, Date Farms, Nurseries, HOA Maintenance, Resort Properties
Recommended Uses: Palm tree planting, date palm nutrition, tropical tree maintenance
Gardener Usage Instructions: Spread 2-3 inches around the base of palms out to the drip line. Work lightly into the top layer of soil and water deeply.

Subtitle: Vineyard Blend
Brief Overview: Crafted for vineyards and grape production. Bacchus Blend provides the organic matter and mineral balance grapevines need for deep root systems, balanced growth, and quality fruit development.
Key Features/benefits: Supports deep vine root establishment, improves soil tilth in vineyard rows, balanced nutrition for grape quality.
Target audience: Vineyards, Wine Growers, Grape Farms, Agricultural Operations
Recommended Uses: Vineyard row amendment, new vine planting, vine topdressing
Gardener Usage Instructions: Incorporate 2-4 inches into vineyard rows before planting, or topdress along established vine rows each season.

Subtitle: Avocado & Citrus Tree Plant Food
Brief Overview: Specifically formulated for avocado and citrus trees. This blend delivers the nutrients these subtropical trees demand for healthy canopy growth, strong fruit production, and robust root systems.
Key Features/benefits: Tailored for citrus and avocado nutrient needs, promotes fruit quality, supports root zone health.
Target audience: Citrus Growers, Avocado Farms, Nurseries, Landscapers, Home Gardeners
Recommended Uses: Citrus tree planting, avocado grove amendment, fruit tree maintenance
Gardener Usage Instructions: Apply 2-3 inches around the tree from trunk to drip line. Gently work into the soil surface and water deeply.

Brand name: Pome & Stone Fruit Tree Plant Food
Subtitle: Pome & Stone Fruit Tree Plant Food
Brief Overview: Designed for apple, pear, peach, and other pome and stone fruit trees. Pomona Blend provides the balanced organic nutrition these trees need for heavy fruit sets and sustained health.
Key Features/benefits: Supports fruit-bearing vigor, improves soil around fruit tree root zones, balanced organic nutrition.
Target audience: Orchards, Fruit Growers, Nurseries, Home Gardeners
Recommended Uses: Fruit tree planting, orchard row amendment, established tree topdressing
Gardener Usage Instructions: Apply 2-3 inches around the drip line of fruit trees. Work into the soil surface and water thoroughly.

Subtitle: Mycorrhizal Root Enhancer
Brief Overview: A mycorrhizal-enriched blend that supercharges root networks. Stoned Ape's extends root reach for better nutrient and water uptake, making plants more resilient and productive.
Key Features/benefits: Contains beneficial mycorrhizal fungi, extends root network, improves nutrient uptake efficiency.
Target audience: Nurseries, Landscapers, Organic Farmers, Cannabis Growers, Home Gardeners
Recommended Uses: Transplanting, new plantings, root zone inoculation, container gardening
Gardener Usage Instructions: Mix into the planting hole or root zone at a 1:4 ratio with native soil. Best applied at transplanting for maximum colonization.

Subtitle: Drought Resilience Soil Amendment
Brief Overview: Engineered for water-scarce landscapes. Desert Defender improves soil water-holding capacity and reduces irrigation needs, keeping plants healthy through Arizona's toughest dry spells.
Key Features/benefits: Increases water retention, reduces irrigation frequency, builds drought-resistant soil biology.
Target audience: Landscapers, HOA Maintenance, Municipal Parks, Golf Courses, Homeowners
Recommended Uses: Drought-prone landscapes, water-wise garden beds, desert xeriscaping
Gardener Usage Instructions: Incorporate 2-3 inches into the top 6 inches of soil. Ideal for pre-planting preparation in low-water landscapes.

Subtitle: Silt Soil Drought Blend
Brief Overview: Formulated specifically for silty soils that struggle with water retention. Silky Silt Saver improves soil structure, reduces compaction, and helps silty ground hold moisture where plants need it.
Key Features/benefits: Targets silt soil problems, improves drainage and moisture balance, reduces surface crusting.
Recommended Uses: Silt soil correction, drought preparation, field amendment
Gardener Usage Instructions: Incorporate 2-4 inches into silty soil before planting. Reapply annually for continued improvement.

Subtitle: Clay Soil Drought Blend
Brief Overview: Built to break up heavy clay soils. Clay Cure improves drainage, reduces waterlogging, and creates a healthier root environment in clay-dominated landscapes.
Key Features/benefits: Breaks up heavy clay, improves drainage and aeration, builds organic matter in clay soils.
Recommended Uses: Clay soil correction, drainage improvement, garden bed preparation
Gardener Usage Instructions: Work 3-4 inches into heavy clay soil before planting. For established beds, topdress and let rain or irrigation work it in over time.

Subtitle: Biochar Mineral
Brief Overview: Pure, uncharged biochar for soil builders who want to create their own custom blends. Mix with compost to activate, then add to soil for permanent carbon storage and improved nutrient retention.
Key Features/benefits: Permanent soil carbon, massive surface area for microbial habitat, improves CEC when charged with compost.
Target audience: Organic Farmers, Soil Scientists, Nurseries, Regenerative Agriculture, Advanced Gardeners
Recommended Uses: Custom soil blending, compost charging, long-term soil building, carbon sequestration
Gardener Usage Instructions: Mix biochar with finished compost at a 1:1 ratio and let sit 2-4 weeks to 'charge'. Then blend into soil at 5-10% by volume. Do not apply raw biochar directly to plants.

Subtitle: Natural Mineral Soil Conditioner
Brief Overview: Natural volcanic mineral that dramatically improves water retention and nutrient availability. Zeolite acts as a molecular sieve, holding water and nutrients where plant roots can access them.
Key Features/benefits: Superior water retention, improves nutrient availability, permanent soil structure improvement.
Target audience: Farms, Landscapers, Golf Courses, Nurseries, Sports Turf
Recommended Uses: Water retention improvement, sandy soil amendment, turf management, container media additive
Gardener Usage Instructions: Blend into soil at 5-15% by volume depending on soil type. Higher rates for sandy soils, lower for loam.

Subtitle: Sulfur-Potassium Nutrition Boost
Brief Overview: A targeted sulfur and potassium source for lowering soil pH and boosting potassium levels. Ideal for alkaline desert soils where plants struggle with nutrient lockout.
Key Features/benefits: Lowers soil pH (avg 2.5-3.5), provides readily available sulfur and potassium, corrects alkaline soil issues.
Target audience: Farms, Nurseries, Blueberry/Acid-Loving Plant Growers, Soil Scientists
Recommended Uses: pH correction for alkaline soils, potassium supplementation, acid-loving plant beds
Gardener Usage Instructions: Apply at 1-2 lbs per 100 sq ft for pH adjustment. Test soil pH before and after application. Do not over-apply.
